components.title: Kale sauce
ingredients: a little chili oil or clabbering chilies or red pepper flakes (optional)
steps: Boil water and season with salt. Add kale and cook until it starts to wet.
Transfer to ice water. Stir until cooled, then drain and squeeze out as much water as possible.
Add kale to a blender with olive oil, Parmesan cheese, garlic, salt, and a little chili oil or clabbering chilies or red pepper flakes, if desired. Blend until smooth.
Heat the sauce in a pan. Boil pasta and add to the sauce.
Add 1 tablespoon cold, cubed butter and toss until glossy.
Top with kale chips and Parmesan crisp.
